experiments.name: Checkout urgency banner
experiments.narrative: The checkout winner has revenue lift, but guardrail pressure and conflicting metrics make full rollout unsafe.
experiments.nextAction: Hold rollout, reconcile conflicting conversion and refund signals, and rerun QA on checkout variants.

experiments.name: Pricing page proof strip
experiments.narrative: Pricing proof is usable with watch conditions, but attribution evidence is not yet clean enough for broad reuse.
experiments.nextAction: Ship to one segment with revenue guardrails and attach attribution proof before expanding.

experiments.name: Trial onboarding sequence
experiments.narrative: Trial onboarding has strong sample, attribution, and guardrail evidence for a controlled rollout.
experiments.nextAction: Roll out with rollback triggers tied to activation and support-contact guardrails.

experiments.name: Enterprise demo CTA
experiments.narrative: Enterprise CTA is rollout-ready with current QA, attribution, and guardrail evidence.
experiments.nextAction: Roll out and keep weekly demo-quality and pipeline-value guardrails attached.
